decision.p2_gate: run A_BroadcastChem4 only if delta_rmse(P1) >= 0.03, delta_mae(P1) >= 0 and the P1 gain is not tail-dependent

verdict_rules.CHEMICAL_FEATURE_INFORMATION_PROMISING: P1 gate passed and P2 also reaches 0.03 and the P1-P2 gap is below 0.015
verdict_rules.INCONCLUSIVE: P1 delta_rmse >= 0.03 but MAE worsens or the gain is tail-dependent
verdict_rules.LOCAL_CHEM_ALIGNMENT_PROMISING: P1 gate passed and (P2 fails the 0.03 gate or delta_rmse(P1) - delta_rmse(P2) >= 0.015)

frozen_constants.standardisation: fold1 train atoms only (mean/std); zero-variance columns -> scale 1

training_loop.extension: v4 builder dispatch + patched v2_data.collate appending the 4 atom columns

forbidden: additional atom features or feature combinations

runs.description: P2: molecule-mean AtomChem4 broadcast to every atom (same features, no atom correspondence)

verdict_rules.CHEMICAL_FEATURE_INFORMATION_PROMISING: P1 gate passed and P2 also reaches materiality and the P1-P2 gap is below alignment_gap_material
verdict_rules.INCONCLUSIVE: P1 delta_rmse >= materiality but MAE worsens or the gain is tail-dependent
verdict_rules.LOCAL_CHEM_ALIGNMENT_PROMISING: P1 gate passed and (P2 delta_rmse < materiality or P1 delta_rmse - P2 delta_rmse >= alignment_gap_material)
verdict_rules.NO_CLEAR_LOCAL_CHEM_GAIN: P1 delta_rmse < materiality (P2 is not run)
